Prompt:
Create an HTML, CSS, and JavaScript component that will appear above the Add to Cart CTA.
Functional Requirements
Display 3 different shipping messages.
Only one message should be visible at a time.
The messages should rotate automatically every 5 seconds in a loop.
The section must remain the same size while messages change.
Messages and Icons
Each message should contain an icon on the left and text on the right.
Icon: https://cdn.convertcart.com/uploads/3b220fb0.svg
Text: Orders shipped in the next 1–2 working days
Icon: https://cdn.convertcart.com/uploads/a22b836b.svg
Text: All US orders shipped from our New York warehouse
Icon: https://cdn.convertcart.com/uploads/ebbf1224.svg
Text: All CAD orders shipped from our Montreal warehouse
Design Requirements
Text color: #333333
Section background color: #2F71B514
Content should be center aligned horizontally
Icon and text should be vertically centered
Add comfortable padding on all sides of the text
Ensure the component is responsive for mobile and desktop
Animation Behavior
Messages should fade or slide smoothly when switching.
Change message every 5 seconds automatically.
The animation should loop infinitely.
Code Requirements
Provide clean HTML structure
Use CSS for styling
Use JavaScript for rotating the messages
